    return "\n".join(lines) + "\n"


def atomic_write_text(path: Path, text: str) -> None:
    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    fd, temp = tempfile.mkstemp(prefix=f".{path.name}.", dir=str(path.parent))
    try:
        with os.fdopen(fd, "w", encoding="utf-8") as stream:
            stream.write(text)
            stream.flush()
            os.fsync(stream.fileno())
        os.replace(temp, path)
    finally:
        with contextlib.suppress(FileNotFoundError):
            os.unlink(temp)


def atomic_write_json(path: Path, value: Any) -> None:
    atomic_write_text(path, json.dumps(value, ensure_ascii=False, sort_keys=True, indent=2) + "\n")


def digest_of(value: Any) -> str:
    return hashlib.sha256(json.dumps(value, ensure_ascii=False, sort_keys=True,
                                     separators=(",", ":")).encode()).hexdigest()


@contextlib.contextmanager
def single_writer(root: Path):
    lock_path = root / ".dev-graph" / "locks" / "graph.lock"
    lock_path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    handle = os.open(lock_path, os.O_CREAT | os.O_RDWR, 0o600)
    try:
        fcntl.flock(handle, fcntl.LOCK_EX)
        yield
    finally:
        fcntl.flock(handle, fcntl.LOCK_UN)
        os.close(handle)


def validate_staged(root: Path, staged_graph: Path) -> dict[str, Any]:
    cp = subprocess.run(
        [sys.executable, str(PLUGIN / "scripts" / "validate-graph-schema.py"),
         "--graph", str(staged_graph), "--repo-root", str(root)],
        text=True, capture_output=True, check=False)
    if cp.returncode == 2:
        raise ContractError(f"validator failed: {cp.stderr.strip()}")
    return json.loads(cp.stdout)


def build_node(root: Path, plan: dict[str, Any], existing: dict[str, Any] | None, now: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
    kind = plan["artifact_kind"]
    node = {
        "graph_node_id": plan["graph_node_id"],
        "artifact_kind": kind,
        "artifact_subtypes": plan.get("artifact_subtypes", []),
        "title": plan["title"],
        "project_id": plan["project_id"],
        "domain": plan["domain"],
        "status": plan.get("status", "draft"),
        "owners": plan.get("owners", []),
        "tags": plan.get("tags", []),
        "priority": plan.get("priority"),
        "start_date": plan.get("start_date"),
        "target_date": plan.get("target_date"),
        "iteration": plan.get("iteration"),
        "created_at": (existing or {}).get("created_at", now),
        "updated_at": now,
        "depends_on": plan.get("depends_on", []),
        "related_nodes": plan.get("related_nodes", []),
        "resource_scope": plan.get("resource_scope", []),
        "purpose": plan.get("purpose"),
        "goal": plan.get("goal"),
        "scope_in": plan.get("scope_in", []),
        "scope_out": plan.get("scope_out", []),
        "acceptance": plan.get("acceptance", []),
        "architecture_refs": plan.get("architecture_refs", []),
        "parent_feature": None,
        "feature_package_id": None,
        "phase_ref": None,
        "file_path": plan["file_path"],
        "template_id": plan.get("template_id", kind),
        "template_version": CONTRACT["template_version"],
        "confirmation_status": plan.get("confirmation_status", "draft"),
        "evaluation_status": plan.get("evaluation_status", "pending"),
        "confirmation_evidence": {"evaluator": None, "evidence_ref": None, "evaluated_digest": None},
        "source_lineage": {
            "origin_kind": "manual", "source_plugin": None,
            "source_path": plan["source_path"], "source_version": plan.get("source_version"),
            "source_digest": plan["source_digest"], "imported_at": (existing or {}).get(
                "source_lineage", {}).get("imported_at", now),
        },
        "classification_confidence": plan["classification_confidence"],
        "classification_reason": plan["classification_reason"],
        "classification_candidates": plan["classification_candidates"],
        "tracker_binding": plan.get("tracker_binding", "none"),
        "beads_linkage": None,
        "github_publication": {"mode": "local_only", "project_aliases": [], "labels": [], "milestone": None},
        "issue_linkage": None,
        "github_project_linkages": [],
        "pull_request_linkages": [],
        "execution_contexts": [],
        "completion_evidence": {"policy": "manual", "status": "not_applicable", "source": None,
                                "completed_at": None, "reconciled_at": None, "evidence_refs": []},
        "implementation_readiness": {"status": "complete", "missing_sections": [], "checked_at": now},
    }
    if kind not in ROOT_BY_KIND:
        raise ContractError(f"unsupported artifact_kind for normal routing: {kind}")
    if kind == "feature":
        raise ContractError(
            "feature nodes require the C14 macro package contract; normal add cannot register features/")
    if not node["file_path"].startswith(ROOT_BY_KIND[kind] + "/"):
        raise ContractError(f"path parity error: {node['file_path']} is not under {ROOT_BY_KIND[kind]}/")
    return node


def apply(args: argparse.Namespace) -> dict[str, Any]:
    root = Path(args.repo_root).resolve(strict=True)
    plan = load_json(Path(args.plan))
    graph_path = contained(root / ".dev-graph/state/graph.json", root)
    staging = root / ".dev-graph/cache/c02-staging" / plan["stage_id"]
    staging.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    now = utc()
    receipt: dict[str, Any] = {
        "owner": "C02/run-dev-graph-node", "operation": plan["operation"], "stage_id": plan["stage_id"],
        "repository_id": plan["repository_id"], "expected_count": len(plan["items"]),
        "applied_count": 0, "status": "rejected", "items": [], "committed_at": None,
    }
    with single_writer(root):
        graph = load_json(graph_path)
        nodes = list(graph.get("nodes", []))
        by_id = {node.get("graph_node_id"): index for index, node in enumerate(nodes)}
        staged_files: list[tuple[Path, str]] = []
        section_findings: dict[str, list[str]] = {}
        for item in plan["items"]:
            body = Path(item["body_path"]).read_text(encoding="utf-8")
            existing = nodes[by_id[item["graph_node_id"]]] if item["graph_node_id"] in by_id else None
            if plan["operation"] == "add" and existing is not None:
                raise ContractError(f"node already exists: {item['graph_node_id']}")
            if plan["operation"] == "update" and existing is None:
                raise ContractError(f"node does not exist: {item['graph_node_id']}")
            if existing is not None and existing["file_path"] != item["file_path"]:
                raise ContractError("update must not move the canonical path")
            findings = body_findings(body, item["artifact_kind"],
                                     item.get("artifact_subtypes", []), item.get("api_changed", False))
            if findings:
                section_findings[item["graph_node_id"]] = findings
            node = build_node(root, item, existing, now)
            target = contained(root / node["file_path"], root, must_exist=False)
            document = frontmatter(node) + "\n" + body.lstrip("\n")
            (staging / f"{node['graph_node_id']}.md").write_text(document, encoding="utf-8")
            staged_files.append((target, document))
            if existing is None:
                nodes.append(node)
            else:
                nodes[by_id[item["graph_node_id"]]] = node
            receipt["items"].append({"graph_node_id": node["graph_node_id"],
                                     "artifact_kind": node["artifact_kind"],
                                     "file_path": node["file_path"],
                                     "artifact_subtypes": node["artifact_subtypes"],
                                     "template_id": node["template_id"],
                                     "classification_confidence": node["classification_confidence"]})
        if section_findings:
            receipt["section_findings"] = section_findings
            raise ContractError(f"required section/template check failed: {section_findings}")

        # materialize artifacts, then validate the staged graph, then commit the graph.
        created = [target for target, _ in staged_files if not target.exists()]
        previous = {target: target.read_text(encoding="utf-8") for target, _ in staged_files if target.exists()}
        try:
            for target, document in staged_files:
                atomic_write_text(target, document)
            proposed = dict(graph)
            proposed["nodes"] = nodes
            proposed["graph_revision"] = int(graph.get("graph_revision", 0)) + 1
            staged_graph = staging / "graph.candidate.json"
            atomic_write_json(staged_graph, proposed)
            report = validate_staged(root, staged_graph)
            receipt["validation"] = {"valid": report["valid"], "violations": report["violations"],
                                     "missing_sections": report["missing_sections"]}
            if not report["valid"]:
                raise ContractError(f"pre-commit validation failed: {report['violations']}")
            atomic_write_json(graph_path, proposed)
        except Exception:
            for target in created:
                with contextlib.suppress(FileNotFoundError):
                    target.unlink()
            for target, text in previous.items():
                atomic_write_text(target, text)
            raise
        receipt.update({
            "status": "applied", "applied_count": len(plan["items"]),
            "graph_revision_before": int(graph.get("graph_revision", 0)),
            "graph_revision_after": proposed["graph_revision"],
            "graph_digest_after": digest_of(proposed),
            "registered_node_ids": [item["graph_node_id"] for item in receipt["items"]],
            "committed_at": utc(),
        })
    atomic_write_json(Path(args.receipt), receipt)
    return receipt


def main() -> int:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    parser.add_argument("--repo-root", required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--plan", required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--receipt", required=True)
    args = parser.parse_args()
    receipt = apply(args)
    print(json.dumps(receipt, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2, sort_keys=True))
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    try:
        raise SystemExit(main())
    except ContractError as exc:
        print(json.dumps({"status": "rejected", "applied_count": 0, "error": str(exc)},
                         ensure_ascii=False, indent=2), file=sys.stderr)
        raise SystemExit(1)

"""Machine verification of the C02 live trial end state (C11 + kind/section/path checks)."""
import json
import re
import subprocess
import sys
from pathlib import Path

import yaml

ROOT = Path("/Users/dm/dev/dev/個人開発/harness/eval-log/dev-graph/live-trial-fixtures/r5-node")
PLUGIN = Path("/Users/dm/dev/dev/個人開発/harness/plugins/dev-graph")
CONTRACT = json.loads((PLUGIN / "templates/template-contract.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
ROOT_BY_KIND = {"issue": "issues", "task": "tasks", "specification": "specs",
                "architecture": "architecture", "feature": "features", "document": "docs"}
checks: list[dict] = []


def check(name: str, ok: bool, detail) -> None:
    checks.append({"check": name, "result": "PASS" if ok else "FAIL", "detail": detail})


def headings(text: str) -> list[str]:
    return [m.group(2).strip() for m in re.finditer(r"^(#{1,6})\s+(.+?)\s*$", text, re.M)]


def template_headings(name: str) -> list[str]:
    return headings((PLUGIN / "templates" / name).read_text(encoding="utf-8"))


# C11 gate
cp = subprocess.run([sys.executable, str(PLUGIN / "scripts/validate-graph-schema.py"),
                     "--graph", str(ROOT / ".dev-graph/state/graph.json"), "--repo-root", str(ROOT)],
                    text=True, capture_output=True, check=False)
report = json.loads(cp.stdout) if cp.stdout else {"valid": False, "violations": [cp.stderr]}
check("C11_validate_graph_schema", cp.returncode == 0 and report.get("valid") is True,
      {"exit": cp.returncode, "violations": report.get("violations"),
       "missing_sections": report.get("missing_sections")})

graph = json.loads((ROOT / ".dev-graph/state/graph.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
nodes = graph["nodes"]
docs = {}
for node in nodes:
    text = (ROOT / node["file_path"]).read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    front, body = text.split("---\n", 2)[1], text.split("---\n", 2)[2]
    docs[node["graph_node_id"]] = (node, yaml.safe_load(front), body)

# 1. five kinds, one node each, canonical roots
kinds = sorted(node["artifact_kind"] for node in nodes)
check("five_kinds_registered", kinds == ["architecture", "document", "issue", "specification", "task"], kinds)
check("path_parity_by_kind",
      all(node["file_path"].startswith(ROOT_BY_KIND[node["artifact_kind"]] + "/") for node in nodes),
      {node["artifact_kind"]: node["file_path"] for node in nodes})

# 2. frontmatter required keys + graph parity (real YAML parse)
required_front = set(CONTRACT["common_frontmatter"]["required"])
front_missing = {node_id: sorted(required_front - set(front)) for node_id, (_, front, _) in docs.items()}
check("frontmatter_required_keys", all(not v for v in front_missing.values()), front_missing)
parity_keys = ("graph_node_id", "artifact_kind", "file_path", "template_id", "template_version")
parity = {node_id: [key for key in parity_keys if front.get(key) != node.get(key)]
          for node_id, (node, front, _) in docs.items()}
check("frontmatter_graph_parity", all(not v for v in parity.values()), parity)

# 3. kind required sections (+ architecture subtype templates)
section_gaps = {}
for node_id, (node, front, body) in docs.items():
    kind = node["artifact_kind"]
    required = list(CONTRACT["artifacts"][kind]["required_sections"])
    for subtype in node["artifact_subtypes"]:
        name = (CONTRACT["artifacts"][kind].get("subtype_templates") or {}).get(subtype)
        if name:
            required.extend(template_headings(name))
    found = set(headings(body))
    gaps = [title for title in required if title not in found]
    if gaps:
        section_gaps[node_id] = gaps
check("kind_required_sections_zero_missing", not section_gaps, section_gaps)

# 4. architecture subtypes declared and applied
arch = next(item for item in docs.values() if item[0]["artifact_kind"] == "architecture")
arch_node, arch_front, arch_body = arch
check("architecture_subtypes_backend_security",
      sorted(arch_node["artifact_subtypes"]) == ["backend", "security"]
      and sorted(arch_front["artifact_subtypes"]) == ["backend", "security"],
      {"node": arch_node["artifact_subtypes"], "frontmatter": arch_front["artifact_subtypes"]})
check("architecture_subtype_sections_applied",
      all(title in set(headings(arch_body))
          for title in template_headings("architecture-backend.md") + template_headings("architecture-security.md")),
      {"backend_head": template_headings("architecture-backend.md")[0],
       "security_head": template_headings("architecture-security.md")[0]})

# 5. API specification overlay
spec_node, spec_front, spec_body = next(item for item in docs.values()
                                        if item[0]["artifact_kind"] == "specification")
api_sections = [h for h in template_headings("api-contract.md") if not h.startswith("API:")]
blocks = re.split(r"^###\s+API:\s+", spec_body, flags=re.M)[1:]
api_gaps = {}
for block in blocks:
    name = block.splitlines()[0].strip()
    found = set(headings(block))
    gaps = [title for title in api_sections if title not in found]
    if gaps:
        api_gaps[name] = gaps
check("api_specification_subtype", "api" in spec_node["artifact_subtypes"], spec_node["artifact_subtypes"])
check("api_contract_overlay_sections_zero_missing", bool(blocks) and not api_gaps,
      {"operations": len(blocks), "gaps": api_gaps})

# 6. no direct feature registration
feature_nodes = [node for node in nodes if node["artifact_kind"] == "feature"]
features_dir = sorted(p.name for p in (ROOT / "features").iterdir())
probe = json.loads((ROOT / "eval-log/run-dev-graph-node-receipt-feature-direct-add.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
check("zero_direct_feature_nodes", not feature_nodes and not features_dir,
      {"feature_nodes": len(feature_nodes), "features_dir": features_dir})
check("feature_direct_add_fail_closed",
      probe["status"] == "rejected" and probe["applied_count"] == 0, probe["error"])

# 7. placeholder tokens absent in managed bodies
placeholders = {node_id: [token for token in CONTRACT["placeholder_tokens"] if token in body]
                for node_id, (_, _, body) in docs.items()}
check("no_placeholder_tokens", all(not v for v in placeholders.values()), placeholders)

# 8. consecutive update identity invariance
add = json.loads((ROOT / "eval-log/run-dev-graph-node-receipt-add.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
u1 = json.loads((ROOT / "eval-log/run-dev-graph-node-receipt-update-1.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
u2 = json.loads((ROOT / "eval-log/run-dev-graph-node-receipt-update-2.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
issue_add = next(item for item in add["items"] if item["artifact_kind"] == "issue")
ids = {issue_add["graph_node_id"], u1["items"][0]["graph_node_id"], u2["items"][0]["graph_node_id"]}
paths = {issue_add["file_path"], u1["items"][0]["file_path"], u2["items"][0]["file_path"]}
issue_body = docs[issue_add["graph_node_id"]][2]
check("update_identity_and_path_invariant", len(ids) == 1 and len(paths) == 1,
      {"ids": sorted(ids), "paths": sorted(paths)})
check("update_appended_without_full_rewrite",
      "1 回目の追記" in issue_body and "2 回目の追記" in issue_body
      and set(CONTRACT["artifacts"]["issue"]["required_sections"]) <= set(headings(issue_body)),
      {"appends": 2, "sections": len(headings(issue_body))})

# 9. receipt/graph revision agreement
check("receipt_revision_chain",
      add["graph_revision_after"] == 1 and u1["graph_revision_after"] == 3
      and u2["graph_revision_after"] == graph["graph_revision"] == 4,
      {"add": add["graph_revision_after"], "u1": u1["graph_revision_after"],
       "u2": u2["graph_revision_after"], "graph": graph["graph_revision"]})
check("receipt_node_ids_match_graph",
      sorted(add["registered_node_ids"]) == sorted(node["graph_node_id"] for node in nodes),
      sorted(add["registered_node_ids"]))

# 10. containment: every stored path repository-relative and inside root
stored = [node["file_path"] for node in nodes] + [s for node in nodes for s in node["resource_scope"]]
check("stored_paths_repository_relative",
      all(not Path(p).is_absolute() and ".." not in Path(p).parts for p in stored), len(stored))

summary = {"scenario_id": "C02-OUT1-positive-mixed-artifacts",
           "overall": "PASS" if all(item["result"] == "PASS" for item in checks) else "FAIL",
           "checks": checks}
print(json.dumps(summary, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2))
sys.exit(0 if summary["overall"] == "PASS" else 1)
